title: FAQ
description: Accessible accordion of frequently asked questions with FAQ structured data.

intro.default: Everything you need to know about our dairy, deliveries and farm visits.

contactText.default: Our family team is happy to help — call or email us any day of the week.

default.question: Is your milk pasteurised?
default.answer: Yes. We use gentle low-temperature pasteurisation that keeps the natural flavour and nutrients while ensuring complete safety. We never add preservatives.

default.question: Which areas do you deliver to?
default.answer: We deliver every morning within a 40 km radius of the farm. Enter your postcode at checkout to confirm your delivery day.

default.question: Can I pause or change my subscription?
default.answer: Of course. You can pause, skip or change your order any time before 8pm for the next morning's delivery.

default.question: How do the returnable glass bottles work?
default.answer: Simply rinse your empty bottles and leave them out on your next delivery day. We collect, sterilise and reuse them.

default.question: Can we visit the farm?
default.answer: Yes! Our farm shop is open Monday to Saturday and we host family open days every month — see our news page for dates.
